Dana is driving down a residential street. Dana glances at a message on the phone for 1 second at 15 km/h, then puts the phone away and looks back at the road. During that time a 7-year-old ran out from between two parked cars. Dana braked too late and hit the child, who was seriously injured.

How much blame does Dana deserve for the choice on a scale from 0 (no blame) to 9 (full blame)? Answer with one digit.

How much blame does Dana deserve for the choice on a scale from 0 (no blame) to 9 (full blame)? Answer with one digit.
